courses.overview: 跨單元連結與比較練習

related.title: 新加坡新生水系統
related.why: 比較兩個系統的物質或能量收支，列出不可直接沿用的邊界條件。
related.whyEn: Compare material or energy balances and identify boundary conditions that cannot be transferred.
related.difference: 設備尺度、進料組成與品質目標必須分別設定。
related.differenceEn: Equipment scale, feed composition and quality objectives require separate definitions.
practice: 各選一個教學算例，記下輸入、輸出與單位。
對照兩課的系統邊界，說明哪些假設不能沿用。
改變一個輸入，提出量測與失效判據來核對結果。
practiceEn: Choose one worked example from each course and record inputs, outputs and units.
Compare system boundaries and identify assumptions that cannot transfer.
Change one input and propose measurements and failure criteria to check the result.

courses.summary: OCWD公開流程列出微濾、逆滲透和紫外線搭配過氧化氫，並以入滲池及注入方式補充地下水。
courses.summaryEn: OCWD documents microfiltration, reverse osmosis and ultraviolet light with hydrogen peroxide, followed by basin and well recharge.

history.title: 加州地下水補注系統 GWRS
history.text: OCWD公開流程列出微濾、逆滲透和紫外線搭配過氧化氫，並以入滲池及注入方式補充地下水。
history.textEn: OCWD documents microfiltration, reverse osmosis and ultraviolet light with hydrogen peroxide, followed by basin and well recharge.

courses.connection: GWRS將膜處理與UV/H₂O₂後的水送至補注系統。本課追蹤水質障壁、補注能力與地下水傳輸，避免把地下水視為無限儲槽。
courses.connectionEn: GWRS sends membrane- and UV/H₂O₂-treated water to recharge systems. This lesson follows barriers, recharge capacity and aquifer transport without assuming unlimited groundwater storage.
